reviews.comment: Anum Ahmed is extremely sweet to her students, extremely funny, and was very very real with us- in this class we covered real topics happening around us, and most of the classwork was either listening to her lectures, working on a project, or performing a dialogue with other classmates, who you will get to know decently well. RECOMMEND!!!!!

She was nice. The course was more difficult than with other professors that teach COMM 210 but it was a pretty standard college course, I honestly don't know how people did really bad in her class. There was 2 big projects that all revolve around groups so make you have a good one. She did interactive activities that were fun.

The class in itself was easy. You just had to give four 5-6 min long speeches in front of like 20 kids. As tedious as it sounds tho, participation did matter because it was such an easy class. She allows 3 excused absences but beyond that your grade starts to drop. She does offer makeup assignments for those missed days and extra credit. Easy A
